intent: Extend Photos with common video and RAW media support across shared contracts, worker derivatives, API playback, Web UI, packaging, tests, and documentation.

findings.title: Video cache could retain replaced source content
evidence: The playback route now derives the cache source size and modification time from a live stat call instead of the last indexed asset metadata.

findings.title: RAW decoder output was not validated
evidence: RAW conversion now confirms that the generated TIFF is decodable before passing it into the derivative pipeline.

findings.title: Web workspace omitted its direct shared dependency
evidence: The workspace now declares @zos/shared, matching its direct photo-config import.

findings.title: Lightbox navigation intercepted video-control arrows
evidence: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight now remain with native controls when the event target is inside the video element.

findings.title: Video canvas bypassed semantic color tokens
evidence: The video background now uses var(--input-deep-bg).

advisory: Run target Debian amd64 and arm64 acceptance with real dcraw_emu, FFmpeg, and representative camera RAW fixtures before release.

verification.tests: passed: 109 Vitest files, 665 tests with 4 skipped, plus Rust and documentation tests
verification.browser: passed at desktop and 820/560/390/320 px widths, including real MP4 poster and playback requests
